connector.name: Famulor
connector.registryDescription: AI voice agents: assistants, calls, campaigns, leads, knowledge bases, WhatsApp, SMS & SIP trunks.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.famulor.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package famulor-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.famulor, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
